entities.name: streetlights
entities.description: Streetlights are outdoor lighting fixtures installed along streets and public areas to provide illumination for safety and visibility. They include various types such as wood pole, concrete pole, and private development streetlights on city right-of-way. The city promotes the use of branded streetlights like Denman Fink lights and maintains street jewelry and monument lighting to enhance urban aesthetics.

entities.name: urban design
entities.description: Urban design involves the arrangement and design of buildings, public spaces, streets, and landscapes to create a functional and aesthetically pleasing environment. It encompasses historical elements, branding, street furniture, lighting, and the overall visual identity of the city to foster community identity and urban coherence.

entities.name: branding
entities.description: Branding refers to the visual and conceptual identity of the city, including symbols, street jewelry, monuments, and street furniture that reflect the city's character and history. It aims to create a distinctive image that fosters civic pride and attracts visitors.
